title: SuperCom Expands into 21st New U.S. State with New Electronic Monitoring Contract in Indiana

Community Corrections Agency Selects SuperCom's PureOne GPS Solution Following Field Evaluation for Adult and Juvenile Programs


Incumbent Vendor Displaced


NEW YORK


, Sept. 22, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- SuperCom (NASDAQ:SPCB ), a global provider of secure solutions for the e-Government, IoT and Cybersecurity sectors, today announced that it has secured a direct county-level electronic monitoring contract with a community corrections agency in Indiana, marking the Company's entry into its 21st new U.S. state since mid-2024. This contract fully displaces the agency's incumbent technology provider.


Under the agreement, SuperCom will deploy its PureOne GPS technology across the agency's adult and juvenile community corrections programs. Training and deployment are scheduled to begin in coming months. The contract was awarded following a field evaluation of SuperCom's equipment and will follow a recurring revenue model.


"The agency evaluated PureOne firsthand in its own operating environment before choosing to replace the platform it already had in place," commented Ordan Trabelsi, President and CEO of SuperCom. "As with many of our recent contracts, when decisions are made through hands-on evaluations, our day-to-day performance becomes a key differentiator: reliability in the field, the quality of the location data and features available to supervision officers, and the support behind the technology. PureOne was selected for both adult and juvenile programs, demonstrating its ability to serve different supervision requirements on a single platform."


"Indiana is our 21ˢᵗ new U.S. state since mid-2024," Trabelsi continued. "Over that period we have entered new markets, deepened our presence in existing ones, displaced incumbent vendors and supported agencies introducing electronic monitoring for the first time. Together with more than 20 national project wins across Europe in recent years, this reflects the range of operating environments our technology supports and the consistency of our execution."


SuperCom's PureOne is an all-in-one GPS tracking bracelet designed for continuous indoor and outdoor location monitoring. Using the latest advancements in location and communication technologies, PureOne delivers highly accurate positioning coupled with advanced tamper detection and dynamic geo-fence alerts and is fully compatible with the other devices in SuperCom's PureSecurity suite. Its integrated design provides correctional and public-safety agencies with a reliable and efficient platform for managing community-supervision programs.


**About SuperCom**


Since 1988, SuperCom has been a global provider of traditional and digital identity solutions, providing advanced safety, identification, and security solutions to governments and organizations, both private and public, worldwide. Through its proprietary e-Government platforms and innovative solutions for traditional and biometrics enrollment, personalization, issuance, and border control services, SuperCom has inspired governments and national agencies to design and issue secure Multi-ID documents and robust digital identity solutions to its citizens and visitors. SuperCom offers a unique all-in-one field-proven RFID & mobile technology and product suite, accompanied by advanced complementary services for various industries, including healthcare and homecare, security and safety, community public safety, law enforcement, electronic monitoring, and domestic violence prevention. For more information, please visit SuperCom's website:[www.supercom.com](https://www.supercom.com/)
